DROPIN = "/etc/systemd/system/robotd.service.d/zzzz-studio-bus.conf"
DROPIN_NAME = "zzzz-studio-bus.conf"
OPLOG_DIR = "/var/lib/microduck-helper"
OPLOG = OPLOG_DIR + "/oplog.jsonl"
CALIB = "/etc/robot/feetech-ft5/hd1910-calibration.toml"
CALIB_SAVED = "/etc/robot/feetech-ft5/hd1910-calibration.saved.toml"
CALIB_PREVIOUS = "/etc/robot/feetech-ft5/hd1910-calibration.previous.toml"
CALIB_BACKUP_DIR = OPLOG_DIR + "/calib-backups"
COMMISSIONING_DROPIN = "/etc/systemd/system/robotd.service.d/zzzz-zz-microduck-commissioning.conf"
IMU_REDO_DIR = OPLOG_DIR + "/imu-recalibrate"
IMU_REDO_MANIFEST = IMU_REDO_DIR + "/manifest.json"
IMU_REDO_DROPIN = "/etc/systemd/system/robotd.service.d/zzzzzz-studio-imu-recalibrate.conf"
IMU_REDO_SCHEMA = "microduck-imu-recalibrate/1"
IMU_CONFIG = "/etc/robot/feetech-ft5/robotd.toml"
IMU_CONFIG_SAVED = "/etc/robot/feetech-ft5/robotd.saved.toml"

"""commissioning = 镜像放的 drop-in 在；motion = 不在且 ExecStart 也没有 --commissioning。
    ExecStart 有而 drop-in 不在：不是镜像设的，不敢自动删 / 切。calib-read 只读，strict=False
    如实报 "foreign"，好让人看见现状；calib-commit 必须 strict=True 拒绝。"""
    if exists(op.ctx, COMMISSIONING_DROPIN):
        return "commissioning", "标定模式，写完要切运动模式"
    start = exec_start(op)
    if "--commissioning" in start:
        if strict:
            raise Stop(EXIT_STATE, "foreign_commissioning",
                       "主程序的标定模式不是镜像设的，不敢自动切，去日志页导出诊断包",
                       {"ExecStart": start, "commissioning_file": COMMISSIONING_DROPIN})
        return "foreign", "ExecStart 里有 --commissioning，但镜像的 drop-in 不在（不是镜像设的，写入不敢自动切）"
    return "motion", "运动模式，只换标定"
